description: Backtest a Verse trading bot (trend-50-200, breakout-20-10, dip-rsi2) on real BTC-USD or ETH-USD daily candles: your parameters, fee, slippage and dates; every trade, the equity curve, max drawdown, buy-and-hold beside it and a walk-forward out-of-sample test. Read only: nothing is traded. Costs 0.05 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) per call, paid with x402 over MCP: call it without payment to get the PaymentRequired terms in structuredContent, then call it again with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. The settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"]. A call that cannot be done (bad input, the service busy) is never charged. The same service over HTTP: POST https://a-to-mind.com/api/x402/backtest.

fee.description: fee per trade as a fraction (0.008 = 0.8%)

slippage.description: slippage per trade as a fraction

name: paid_backtest
title: Backtest a trading bot (0.05 USDC, x402)
